statement: Frozen before any model was evaluated on test fragments, test pairs, the reconstruction pool or Govdocs1. Weights, seeds, hyperparameters, candidate rules, shortlist rule and analysis definitions are not changed after test results are seen.

baselines.ngram_cosine: cosine of 512-bin hashed bigram counts (archived hash table)

regression.pairs: 80,000 sampled test pairs, ordered as sampled (archived convention)
regression.order_reversal: predictions for (b,a) also computed; |p(a,b)-p(b,a)| reported; metrics of 0.5*(p(a,b)+p(b,a)) reported as a secondary analysis
regression.target: each model against its own scheme's target

provenance.pool: distinct test fragments appearing in at least one sampled test pair (archived convention)
provenance.model_scores: S = 0.5*(P+P^T) with P[i,j]=head(z_i,z_j) (archived convention, declared before testing)
provenance.ties: fixed pseudo-random tie-breaking key (numpy default_rng(12345) permutation of pool indices)

auc.same_file_all: pos = same source file, all unordered pairs
auc.same_file_within_type: pairs with equal recorded extension only
auc.same_file_within_type_jpg_jpeg_merged: sensitivity analysis: JPG and JPEG treated as one group

retrieval.relevant: other fragments of the query's source file
retrieval.type_restricted: ORACLE: candidates with the query's recorded extension

adjacency.within_file: ORACLE (archived): candidates restricted to the query's source file
adjacency.pooled: practical: candidates = every other pool fragment; no source identity used
adjacency.queries: fragments with at least one adjacent retained block in the pool

provenance.clustering: average-linkage agglomerative clustering on D = max(S) - S; ORACLE number of clusters = number of source files; ARI and NMI
provenance.jpg_jpeg: primary analyses keep JPG and JPEG as separate recorded-extension groups; merged versions are labelled sensitivity analyses
provenance.fp32_sensitivity: secondary: heuristic_s42, uniform_s42 and learnability_s42 rescored with encoder and pair head in float32 (no autocast); primary results use the archived autocast scoring, whose float16 sigmoid output creates ties

shortlist_workflow.shortlist_model: heuristic_s42 (archived workflow); uniform_s42 and learnability_s42 secondary
shortlist_workflow.selection: M maximising validation MRR on the validation pool (archived rule); ties -> smaller M
shortlist_workflow.effort: rank of the first relevant candidate = candidates inspected; candidates needed for recall 0.5/0.8/0.9/0.95; shortlist recall at the frozen M

reconstruction.pool: test files with >= 24 complete aligned blocks; one run of 24 consecutive blocks per file; start block = random.Random('recon-v1|'+collection_id).randrange(0, n_blocks-24+1)
reconstruction.chaining: unordered pairs in decreasing score (stable); accept if both degrees < 2 and no cycle; stop at n-1 links; scores only (no source identity or offsets)
metrics: adjacency_recall and join_precision over all accepted links (archived procedure, links accepted until n-1, i.e. one path when complete)

oracle_stop: the same link order stopped after n - F links (F = known number of source files) -> chain_purity_weighted, share of fragments in pure chains, files_recovered_as_exact_ordered_sequence (ordering check only; no decoder validation)
reconstruction.design_note: the oracle stop was added after a validation-only dry run showed that the archived n-1 rule always yields a single path, so purity is undefined there

loto_heic.regression: test pairs with / without a HEIC fragment

govdocs1.b4096: model: mean of eight 512-byte window embeddings, re-normalised, then the pair head; baselines on the full 4096-byte fragments
govdocs1.tasks: same as local provenance + greedy chaining; no retraining

bootstrap.duplicates: pair weights c_a*c_b for different files and c_a within a file; pairs between two copies of one file are never formed; query metrics averaged over queries of drawn files with multiplicity, using ranks computed on the full pool
bootstrap.paired_differences: identical file draws for every method; difference method - hist_cosine
bootstrap.chaining: full-pool chaining fixed; files reweighted through per-file contributions (correct and true links per file; accepted links split half per endpoint file; purity attributed to each chain's majority file)
bootstrap.ari: per replicate the distinct drawn files are re-clustered (duplicates collapsed, so no artificial same-file matches); pool-size dependent, reported with that caveat
